pairs.subject: ability-authoring-to-engine
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/useAbilitySpecBinding.ts:147 The editor hydrates persisted generated specs whose acceptance endpoint checks arrays but does not validate their effect and rule entries.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/ability/logic-prompts.ts:49 The blueprint draft path supplies generic conventions and thin ability identity, without a live registry, accepted exemplars, or instructions to read named exemplars.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/blueprint/GeneratedFilesPanel.tsx:44 The panel promotes the callback's buildOk directly into a compile verdict; the shared callback evidence limitation is described in notes.

src/app/api/ability-spec/route.ts:54 The draft callback checks only that both fields are arrays, then casts their entries and persists them without field, bound, relationship, or identifier validation.

pairs.subject: ability-authoring-to-engine
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/_shared/useAbilitySpecTags.ts:25 A failed app-tag fetch silently leaves an empty list, allowing the core audit to treat an unmeasured authoring source as having no references.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/_shared/data.ts:690 The attribution describes an empty list as actual absence, although useAbilitySpecTags also returns that list after failed extraction.

pairs.subject: ability-authoring-to-engine
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/forge/index.tsx:120 A refinement becomes the current adoptable result before its changes are checked against a permitted change scope.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/prompts/ability-forge.ts:216 The briefing uses a hardcoded KNOWN_TAGS constant and one abbreviated reference rather than an authoritative live extraction and complete accepted exemplars.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/forge/index.tsx:120 The prior artifact and minimal-diff instructions exist, but returned changes are accepted before display-only diffing; no permitted closure or scope rejection is enforced.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_ability/forge/index.tsx:133 Selecting history restores the ability without restoring its generating prompt; adoption receives the historical result with the current lastPrompt, breaking exact-input provenance.
src/app/api/agents/forge-ability/route.ts:122 The endpoint repairs fenced output before parsing, contrary to the explicit rule to reject decoration rather than repair it.

src/lib/ability/tag-dialect.ts:36 Forge adoption uses this unconditional convention mapping, which collapses distinct underscore spellings without declaration-based resolution, collision handling, or an unresolved result.

declined.subject: ability-authoring-to-engine
declined.reason: Opened src/stores/abilitySpecStore.ts: it is a per-entity Zustand cache delegating persistence to the API/DB, not the full design suite described; assigning the other contexts' authoring guarantees to this store would not establish a context-local verdict.
